pages.text: Reads a value into a variable.

$(1)variable$() must be the name of one declared variable, without index. A constant or loop variable doesn't work. The function writes into the variable directly. It first looks into the bound I/O blocks for an item with the same name and type, or a literal item of the right type. Otherwise it waits until a player types a line on a bound laptop or tablet.
$(li)$(1)variable$() variable: the variable that receives the value$(li)no results

$(1)PROGRAM typing$(br)NOOP$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION ask$(br)BEGIN$(br)  VARIABLE count INTEGER$(br)  CALL INPUT$(br)    PARAMETER variable count ;$(br)  CALL PRINT$(br)    PARAMETER value count * 2 ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
